rubric.role_summary: Product manager for strategic developer-platform partner integrations, owning a focused portfolio from integration design through delivery, developer feedback, and measurement.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Product manager for strategic developer-platform partner integrations, owning a focused portfolio from integration design through delivery, developer feedback, and measurement.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Either 7+ years of product management on developer tools or experience as an ex-founder.
- Product experience owning APIs, auth or identity flows, or developer-facing platform surfaces.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Familiarity with workers or agent sandboxes, developer-tooling products, or machine-to-machine authentication.
- Either 7+ years of product management on developer tools or experience as an ex-founder; in either case, technically able to read an architecture document and follow a design discussion.
- Have shipped integration or platform surfaces that other companies’ systems build against, with end-to-end ownership of APIs, auth or identity flows, or developer-facing platform surfaces, and be able to reason at the product level about authentication and data exchange between independent systems.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.

soft_requirements: Strong product instincts and ability to ask the right questions in technical discussions.
Bias toward shipping secure work quickly and learning from it.
Uses owned product surfaces firsthand to form opinions.
Comfort using AI tools for research, drafting, and feedback synthesis.
Works asynchronously, makes decisions in writing, and moves work forward without meetings.
